title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Reference Card — Correcting a Revolving Account Late Fee
content:
A late fee on a revolving account is owed on the day after a statement due date when the payments credited from the statement date through the due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due.

When the most recent late fee posted on a revolving account is above its re-rated amount, the excess is reversed as a posting error by one correction entry referencing that late fee.

## Scope

This card covers the revolving tiers of Ridgeline Pro Credit — the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge and Pro Revolving Charge Plus. The correction concerns the most recent late fee on the account. It is booked as one correction entry, with the reason posting error, that references that late fee and reverses the part of it above its re-rated amount; a late fee that does not stand above its re-rated amount carries no correction.

## Booking the correction

The correction is booked by the agent with the task tool `reverse_late_fee_excess_4d4f7d34`. It is a hidden tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** One call corrects a late fee on a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account by reversing part or all of it as a posting error. It books one fee reversal line referencing the late fee line being corrected, dated today and placed in today's statement period, and lowers the account's current balance by the reversed amount. The correction then shows in the account's activity next to the fee.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_account_id` | The reference number of the Ridgeline Pro Credit account the late fee was charged to, as returned by the Pro Credit account lookup | Identifier |
| `original_transaction_id` | The reference number of the late fee line being corrected, as returned by the Pro Credit activity lookup | Identifier |
| `reversal_amount` | The part of the late fee reversed | USD, a positive number rounded to 2 decimal places; booked exactly as given |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "reversed", `trade_transaction_id` (the reference number of the new reversal line), `original_transaction_id` (the late fee line corrected), `reversal_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `transaction_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `current_balance` (the account balance after the correction, USD, 2 decimal places). The tool's contract defines no other outcome.
